install: find . -type d -path '*/node_modules/.vite' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
build: find . -type d -path '*/node_modules/.vite' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm cache clean --force && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm run predeploy --skip-env-check && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm run build:replit
start: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production npm run prepare:runtime-secrets && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false env -u NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION -u npm_config_production NODE_ENV=production node --enable-source-maps artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
